en-US.name: my bridge
en-US.summary: Talks to an MCP server through the alexa-skill-mcp-bridge.
en-US.description: Development skill created by alexa-skill-mcp-bridge. It forwards each turn to an agent on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime, which calls the tools of an MCP server and speaks the results.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask my bridge to search hotels
Alexa, ask my bridge for the weather

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Development only. Needs the CDK stack from alexa-skill-mcp-bridge deployed.
